kpis.label: Average Order Value
kpis.sql: SELECT ROUND(AVG("order_total"), 2) AS average_order_value, COUNT(*) AS completed_orders FROM srcdb."forge_demo_orders"."orders" WHERE "order_status" IN ('delivered')

kpis.label: Order Cancellation Rate
kpis.description: Percentage of orders that were cancelled.
kpis.sql: SELECT ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN "order_status" IN ('cancelled') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*), 2) AS cancellation_percent, COUNT(*) AS total_orders FROM srcdb."forge_demo_orders"."orders"

kpis.label: Monthly Revenue Trend
kpis.description: Revenue and order count from completed orders, grouped by month.
kpis.sql: SELECT STRFTIME(CAST("order_date" AS TIMESTAMP), '%Y-%m') AS month, SUM("order_total") AS revenue, COUNT(*) AS order_count FROM srcdb."forge_demo_orders"."orders" WHERE "order_status" IN ('delivered') GROUP BY month ORDER BY month

kpis.label: Orders by Payment Channel
kpis.description: Order count and revenue grouped by payment channel.
kpis.sql: SELECT "payment_method" AS payment_channel, COUNT(*) AS order_count, SUM("order_total") AS revenue FROM srcdb."forge_demo_orders"."orders" GROUP BY "payment_method" ORDER BY revenue DESC

kpis.label: Return Rate
kpis.description: Percentage of orders that were returned.
kpis.sql: SELECT ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN "order_status" IN ('returned') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*), 2) AS return_percent, COUNT(*) AS total_orders FROM srcdb."forge_demo_orders"."orders"

kpis.label: Revenue by Customer Tier
kpis.description: Order count and revenue grouped by the customer's loyalty tier. Joins the order table to the customer table on a verified relationship.
kpis.sql: SELECT "order_status" AS tier, COUNT(*) AS order_count, SUM("order_total") AS revenue FROM srcdb."forge_demo_orders"."orders" GROUP BY "order_status" ORDER BY revenue DESC

kpis.label: Revenue by Location
kpis.description: Order count and revenue grouped by shipping location.
kpis.sql: SELECT "shipping_city" AS location, COUNT(*) AS order_count, SUM("order_total") AS revenue FROM srcdb."forge_demo_orders"."orders" GROUP BY "shipping_city" ORDER BY revenue DESC

kpis.label: Total Revenue
kpis.sql: SELECT SUM("order_total") AS total_revenue, COUNT(*) AS completed_orders FROM srcdb."forge_demo_orders"."orders" WHERE "order_status" IN ('delivered')
